canonical_statement: For every nonempty bounded open Omega in R^2, exp(4*pi*u^2) has a uniform finite integral over Omega among real u in W_0^{1,2}(Omega) whose weak-gradient energy is at most one; for every alpha > 4*pi, no finite uniform bound exists for the same admissible class.
domain_and_universes: Omega : Set (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)); u : Plane -> Real; g : Plane -> Plane; all declarations in Lean universe 0.

encoding_decisions.zero_boundary_sobolev: Existence of a sequence of smooth functions compactly supported in Omega converging to u and its selected weak gradient in extended L2 seminorm.
encoding_decisions.gradient_energy: The volume lintegral of ENNReal.ofReal norm(g x)^2.
encoding_decisions.endpoint: Existence of one finite ENNReal constant uniformly bounding every admissible u at alpha = 4*pi.
encoding_decisions.sharpness: For every alpha > 4*pi and every finite ENNReal C, an admissible u has exponential integral greater than C.
encoding_decisions.nonempty_domain: Required by the source's domain convention and logically necessary for the sharpness conjunct; the empty-domain exponential integral is always zero.

boundary_policy: The zero function and equality in the gradient constraint remain admitted. The exact endpoint is included; every strictly supercritical exponent is unbounded. Empty domains are excluded explicitly because sharpness would be false.
